item.title: Regional-Scale Critical Mineral Screening (Conceptual Example)
item.description: Multi-sensor fusion workflow applied across ~500 km² to identify high-priority target zones for bauxite and critical minerals, demonstrating regional-scale screening capabilities with high validation rates.

item.title: Remote sensing study for bauxite exploration in the Payas–İslahiye region, SE Turkey
item.description: A multi-sensor remote sensing and fusion mapping study to highlight new bauxite potential in a complex, vegetated terrain — delivering ranked zones, target points and context for existing mines.

item.title: Payas–İslahiye Pilot: Targeting High-Potential Zones
item.description: SAR + multispectral fusion shortlisted four high-confidence bauxite corridors with traceable rationale layers for Payas–İslahiye.
